subject: Re: Redwood pilot — next steps & legal redlines
message_1_subject: Redwood pilot — quick recap & next steps
message_1_body:
Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Goal: 2-week pilot to validate latency/cost on Acme search use case.
- Scope: ~100k queries/day, user-facing reranking + caching.
- Internal owners: Sam (Product), Natalie (Procurement).

Action items:
1) Acme: confirm timing/priority for pilot and any security questionnaire items we should prefill — target decision by 3/16.
2) Redwood: send pilot MAP (attached) + SOW template.
3) Legal: we'll share standard terms; open to limited redlines for pilot.

Attached: Redwood-Pilot-MAP.pdf (pilot plan + SOW template).

If that all looks right, can we lock a kickoff window the week of 3/9?

Thanks,
Marissa
